style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm cozy kids loungewear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm mist off-white #F7F2EC, deep plum #4B2E52 and one mustard-yellow accent #F0B429; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows, warm 5000K window light for lifestyle shots; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline and label text only; consistent soft solid-color circle callouts and thin-line icons; clean kids-wear product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the two-piece set always shown as a matched top and pants with stable polka-dot print scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
